hook: *3,500* road experts in Hyderabad for 4-day Roads Congress
hook_b: *3,500* road experts in Hyderabad for 4-day Roads Congress
tldr: The 85th Indian Roads Congress opens in Hyderabad on Thursday, inaugurated by Union Minister Nitin Gadkari. R&B Minister Komatireddy Venkat Reddy says about 3,500 delegates will discuss green roads, climate-resilient infrastructure, AI and EVs.

beats.what: The four-day 85th IRC conference begins in Hyderabad on Nov 19.
beats.why: Gadkari, CM Revanth Reddy and the R&B minister will also review Telangana road projects including the RRR and Hyderabad–Vijayawada highway.
beats.care: Projects named for priority include the Regional Ring Road, Hyderabad Elevated Corridor and the Future City–Machilipatnam port highway.
